title: EV Charging vs Gas Costs Over 3 Years
text: Have you ever wondered whether an EV or a gas car would be better for you? I’ve been exploring the best states to buy an EV in, and comparing different EVs with their gas counterparts using a data set from AAA. The data is compiled into multiple interactive graphs that lets you visualize charging costs over a span of 3 years compared to gas costs over the same time frame. I have found that the best states to buy an EV in are Washington and California.

title: About
text:
My name is Ayush Chandra and I am in 9th grade at Sharon High School. You find my work on GitHub or contact me at chandra.ayush2021@gmail.com.
My project is about the average cost of paying for gas versus paying for charging over a 3 year period in the US. It also includes comparisons between different EVs and their gas counterparts. The code and data are available at the Github Repo.
This site was created for Kane’s Data Science Bootcamp.

title: Model
text:
LaTeX Code
\[
\begin{equation}
\text{Cost Difference}_i = \beta_0 + \beta_1 \times \text{Regular}_i + \beta_2 \times \text{Cost per kWh}_i + \epsilon_i
\end{equation}
\]
Where:

\(\beta_0\): This represents the cost difference when both gas and charging prices are zero.
\(\beta_1\): This represents how much the cost difference changes for regular gas price.
\(\beta_2\): This represents how much the cost difference changes for charging costs per kWh.
